scripts.stop: lsof -ti :3001 | xargs kill -15 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti :3000 | xargs kill -15 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; lsof -ti :3001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti :3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; pkill -f '.wwebjs_auth/session' 2>/dev/null; echo '✅ All processes stopped'
scripts.dev: concurrently --names ENGINE,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:engine" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.restart: npm run stop && sleep 2 && npm run dev
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:ui && npm --workspace=apps/desktop run dev
scripts.build:desktop:mac: npm run build:ui && npm --workspace=apps/desktop run dist:mac
scripts.build:desktop:win: npm run build:ui && npm --workspace=apps/desktop run dist:win
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api && npm run test:ui
